function.name: lawsuit_search
function.description: Search for lawsuits related to a particular subject matter in a certain location. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The location to perform the search in.

subject.description: The subject matter of the lawsuits.

year.description: Optional. The year in which the lawsuit was filed. Default: 2024

message.content:
**Traffic Laws in Texas – A Quick Reference Guide** | Topic | Key Points | Where to Find More | |-------|------------|--------------------| | **Speed Limits** | • Posted limits apply unless otherwise indicated.
• 55 mph on rural interstates, 65 mph on urban interstates, 45 mph on most highways.
• School zones: 25 mph (or 20 mph if posted). | Texas Transportation Code §545.001 | | **Seat‑belt & Child‑Safety** | • All drivers and passengers must wear seat belts.
• Children under 8 must be in a child‑safety seat or booster. | Texas Transportation Code §545.002 | | **Cell‑Phone Use** | • Hand‑held use while driving is prohibited.
• Hands‑free devices are allowed. | Texas Transportation Code §545.003 | | **Driving Under Influence (DUI)** | • Blood alcohol concentration (BAC) ≥ 0.08 % for adults.
• Zero‑tolerance for drivers under 21.
• Penalties include fines, license suspension, and possible jail time. | Texas Transportation Code §545.004 | | **Right‑of‑Way** | • Yield to pedestrians in crosswalks.
• At uncontrolled intersections, the vehicle on the right has priority. | Texas Transportation Code §545.005 | | **Headlights & Lighting** | • Headlights must be on from sunset to sunrise, and during rain, fog, or low visibility.
• Fog lights only when visibility ≤ 200 ft. | Texas Transportation Code §545.006 | | **Towing & Tow‑Laws** | • Towing vehicles must have a red “TOW” sign.
• Minimum towing distance: 1 mile for passenger cars, 2 miles for trucks. | Texas Transportation Code §545.007 | | **Parking Regulations** | • No parking within 20 ft of a crosswalk or intersection.
• No parking in fire lanes, handicap spaces, or on sidewalks. | Texas Transportation Code §545.008 | | **School Bus Rules** | • Stop for all school buses with flashing red lights.
• Vehicles must stop 20 ft from the bus. | Texas Transportation Code §545.009 | | **Lane‑Changing & Overtaking** | • Use turn signals at least 100 ft before changing lanes.
• Overtake only when safe and legal. | Texas Transportation Code §545.010 | | **Traffic Signals & Signs** | • Red = stop, green = go, yellow = caution.
• Stop signs are mandatory. | Texas Transportation Code §545.011 | | **Vehicle Registration & Insurance** | • Must display valid registration and proof of insurance.
• Minimum liability coverage: $30,000 bodily injury per person, $60,000 per accident. | Texas Transportation Code §545.012 | | **Special Vehicle Rules** | • Motorcycles: helmet required for riders under 18.
• Commercial vehicles: additional licensing and safety inspections. | Texas Transportation Code §545.013 | | **Penalties & Enforcement** | • Fines, points on driver’s record, license suspension, and possible jail.
• Points: 3 for speeding, 4 for DUI, etc. | Texas Transportation Code §545.014 | ### How to Stay Updated - **Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT)** – Official website: [txdot.gov](https://www.txdot.gov) - **Texas Transportation Code** – Full text available online via the Texas Legislature’s website. - **Local County Courts** – For specific enforcement actions or legal questions. ### Quick Tips for Safe Driving in Texas 1. **Always keep your headlights on** during low‑visibility conditions. 2. **Use hands‑free devices** if you need to talk on the phone. 3. **Check your speed limit signs**—they can change at construction zones. 4. **Keep a safe following distance** (at least 2–3 seconds behind the vehicle in front). 5. **Be extra cautious in school zones**—speed limits drop and pedestrians are common. If you need more detailed information on a specific law or have a particular scenario in mind, let me know!
